headline: Polymarket supply-chain attack drains $2M+; Drupal Commerce auth bypass exploited; Binance $6.3B theft; GitLab and Cisco KEV fixes due Nov 1

bullets.text: New: SecurityWeek reports more than $2 million drained from Polymarket traders in a supply chain attack; Polymarket halted trading after a crypto-draining script breach, with $2.5 million traced per BleepingComputer.
Attackers are actively exploiting a highly critical authorization bypass in Drupal Commerce core, CVE-2026-118539.
Binance links the $6.3 billion crypto theft to a compromised DevOps laptop; SecurityWeek reports hallmarks of North Korea's TraderTraitor. Nearly $3 billion is frozen and withdrawals were paused.

CISA added actively exploited GitLab CE/EE RCE CVE-2026-97229 (CVSS 10.0) and Cisco ASA/FTD VPN DoS CVE-2026-76418 to KEV, both due 2026-11-01. An attacker already tried the GitLab flaw against Alpine Linux's instance.
Attackers are exploiting Cisco SD-WAN flaw CVE-2026-20127 to deploy custom KeyDrift malware; the activity is tied to Volt Typhoon's 'Silent Train' network, used in four zero-day campaigns.

China-linked attackers used VMware ESX zero-day CVE-2026-41709 to reduce audit visibility; PHP2Shell and Fragnesia were chained to root firewalls. Exploitation attempts have also begun against Oracle EBS RCE CVE-2026-101767.

actions: If you use Polymarket, stop trading through it until it confirms the malicious script is removed; check wallets for unexpected approvals.
If you run Drupal Commerce, apply the fix for CVE-2026-118539 now and review access logs for authorization bypass attempts.
Patch self-managed GitLab CE/EE for CVE-2026-97229 and Cisco ASA/FTD for CVE-2026-76418 before 2026-11-01; review logs for exploitation.
Patch Cisco SD-WAN for CVE-2026-20127 per Cisco's advisory and hunt for KeyDrift malware on SD-WAN components.
Apply your distro's kernel fix for CVE-2026-46300 before 2026-10-31; patch VMware ESX CVE-2026-41709 and confirm Oracle EBS CVE-2026-101767 is fixed.
Harden DevOps workstations with access to production or signing keys; Binance users should rely only on official status channels.
